desc: Initialize `forced` array of size `N = n + m - 1` with `None`; apply all 'T' constraints by setting `forced[i+j] = str2[j]`, return `""` on conflicts.

Process every 'F' interval: scan positions `i..i+m-1`; skip if any forced character already differs from `str2`; otherwise find the largest still‑free index `p` in that range, return `""` if none exists, and record the required forbidden letter `str2[p-i]` at deadline `p`.

Construct the answer by iterating positions `0..N-1`: if forced, verify it differs from every required letter at that deadline (else `""`) and use it; else if a deadline has required letters, pick the smallest `'a'..'z'` not in that forbidden set; else set `'a'`. Return the joined string.
Verify the solution against the three given examples and edge cases (all 'T', all 'F', n=1, conflicting 'T's, 'F' interval with no free position, overlapping F intervals, maximal constraints).
